custom-functions.function: Function tosif (Num As Number) As String Dim harf As String harf = "" Select Case Num Case -1 harf = "خیلی خوب" Case -2 harf = "خوب" Case -3 harf = "قابل قبول" Case -4 harf = "نیاز به تلاش بیشتر" End Select tosif = Trim(harf) End Function
